name: Mikami
source:
A Veil designer who leads NS's Veil development department. He started at the company at the same time as K, but has since risen far in NS and sometimes acts as a spokesperson as its star designer. Handsome, intelligent and gentle, he is very popular both inside and outside the company.

[From DLsite, translated]
